guidance.bestFor: A bare text box with placeholder text and no label, the smallest markup to start from
agentNotes: The `Input` is named only by its `placeholder`, which vanishes as the user types; add a visible label for real forms

whenNotToUse.when: A field whose name must stay on screen after the user starts typing

guidance.bestFor: An email field with a visible label above it, tied to the box through htmlFor and id

whenNotToUse.when: A label that needs a hover hint explaining what the field is for

guidance.bestFor: A username field with one line of help text printed under the box
agentNotes: `FieldDescription` is not linked to the `Input`; give it an id and set aria-describedby so screen readers read the hint

guidance.bestFor: A labeled email field locked by the disabled attribute, dimmed and skipped by the keyboard
agentNotes: A `disabled` field is skipped by Tab and left out of form data; set readOnly instead when the value must still submit

guidance.bestFor: An email field shown in its red invalid state with a single error line below
agentNotes: `aria-invalid` is hardcoded to true and the `FieldError` text is fixed; set both from your validation result

whenNotToUse.when: Several failed rules listed at once, each with its own warning mark

guidance.bestFor: A 50 character project description with a live typed count across from the label
agentNotes: `maxLength` drives both the browser cap and the counter text, so change that one constant to move the limit

whenNotToUse.when: A description that runs over several lines of text

guidance.bestFor: A plain masked password box with no reveal button and no strength feedback

whenNotToUse.when: A password the user may reveal with an eye button
A new password checked against rules while the user types

guidance.bestFor: A tel field that brings up the phone keypad, with no country menu or number formatting
agentNotes: `type` tel adds no pattern check or formatting, so the number arrives exactly as typed; validate it before saving

whenNotToUse.when: Numbers from many countries that need a flag menu and live formatting

guidance.bestFor: A website address field typed as url, with a full https address as its placeholder
A numeric field typed as number, with the browser's own spin arrows for stepping
agentNotes: Even with `type` number the field's value reads back as a string, so convert it before math or saving

whenNotToUse.when: Quantities stepped with plus and minus buttons inside set limits

guidance.bestFor: A day picked from the browser's built in calendar popup, with no date library
agentNotes: The value of a `type` date field is a yyyy-mm-dd string, never a Date, whatever format the browser displays

whenNotToUse.when: A themed month grid opened from a button, or a from and to span

guidance.bestFor: A native file chooser with the browser's pick button flattened into the field, taking one file
agentNotes: A `type` file field takes 1 file of every format until you add the accept and multiple attributes

whenNotToUse.when: A drop zone with previews, size checks or several picks at once

guidance.bestFor: A company name field whose label ends in a red asterisk to mark it mandatory
agentNotes: The red asterisk is only a `span`; add required or aria-required to the `Input` so browsers and screen readers know

whenNotToUse.when: A form that marks the optional fields rather than the mandatory ones

guidance.bestFor: A native hour and minute field rendered by the browser, with no picker library and no state
agentNotes: The value of a `type` time field is a 24 hour HH:mm string even when the browser shows a 12 hour clock

whenNotToUse.when: A themed clock popover with minute steps, limits or a 12 hour display

name: c-input-15
title: Complex input form with multiple fields
label: Contact Form
description: Complex input form with multiple fields

guidance.bestFor: A short contact form with phone and country side by side, an address line and Cancel and Submit
agentNotes: The `form` has no submit handler, so Submit reloads the page; add onSubmit and call preventDefault
No control carries a name, so FormData read from the `form` comes back empty until you add them

guidance.bestFor: A username label with a help icon that opens a tooltip, repeating the hint as text under the box
agentNotes: `TooltipTrigger` renders a button holding only the help icon, so give it an aria-label for screen readers

guidance.bestFor: An API key field with a New badge in the success tint beside its label

whenNotToUse.when: A tag that tells the user a field may be left empty

guidance.bestFor: A middle name field with a small outlined Optional badge at the far end of the label row

whenNotToUse.when: A form that flags each mandatory field with a red mark

name: c-input-19
title: Input label with link and visibility toggle
label: Link & Toggle
description: Input label with link and visibility toggle

guidance.bestFor: A sign in password with a Forgot password link opposite the label and an eye button to reveal it
agentNotes: The Forgot password link keeps a placeholder `href`; point it at your reset page

whenNotToUse.when: A sign up password that grades itself with one hint line

guidance.bestFor: A name field with its label placed to the left on the same row rather than above
agentNotes: `orientation` horizontal keeps the row on narrow screens; the responsive value stacks it until its FieldGroup parent is wide

guidance.bestFor: A security code field listing 3 failed rules under it, each led by an alert icon
agentNotes: The 3 messages and `aria-invalid` are hardcoded; render the rows inside `FieldError` from your validation result

whenNotToUse.when: Rules shown as a live checklist that ticks off while the user types

name: c-input-22
title: Basic password strength with dynamic hint and icons
label: Strength Hint
description: Basic password strength with dynamic hint and icons

guidance.bestFor: A password with one hint line that turns from grey to red, amber or green as 3 rules pass
agentNotes: `getStrength` counts only the 8 symbols in its regex as special, so a dash or a dot never meets the third rule

whenNotToUse.when: A meter with a segmented bar, a rule checklist and a reveal button

name: c-input-23
title: Advanced password strength indicator with progress
label: Strength Meter
description: Advanced password strength indicator with progress

guidance.bestFor: A 5 rule checklist with ticks, a 5 segment color bar, a met count and an eye toggle
agentNotes: The bar draws 5 segments and the count reads out of 5 by hand, so a rule added to `checkStrength` needs both updated
The eye button's aria-controls names `password`, an id that does not exist; point it at the generated `id`

whenNotToUse.when: A single hint line with no bar or rule checklist

guidance.bestFor: A field behind a pulsing primary tint that stops when focused and resumes on blur
agentNotes: `animate-pulse` keeps running for users who ask for reduced motion; add motion-reduce:animate-none to the overlay
The pulsing overlay is fixed at `rounded-md`, so match it to your input radius or the tint shows past the corners

guidance.bestFor: A field whose focus border and ring turn emerald green in place of the theme ring color
A field filled with the muted surface color, kept the same on hover and focus
An underline style field with a 2px bottom rule that turns primary on focus, with no ring
A browser color swatch that opens the native picker, starting from a blue hex value

whenNotToUse.when: Opacity, preset swatches or oklch and hsl values in a themed popover

guidance.bestFor: A native 0 to 100 range with its current number printed at the end of the label row

whenNotToUse.when: A themed track with 2 thumbs, tick marks or a tooltip over the thumb

guidance.bestFor: A search box with fully rounded ends and wider side padding

whenNotToUse.when: A search box that needs a magnifier icon or a clear button inside it

name: c-input-31
title: Minimal input without borders or background
label: Borderless
description: Minimal input without borders or background

guidance.bestFor: A chromeless field with no border, fill, padding or focus ring, only text and caret
agentNotes: `border-none` and `ring-0` remove every focus mark but the caret, so add a focus style for keyboard users
